newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SOCCER-BARCELONA HELD BY AIK BUT REACH SEMIFINALS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARCELONA HELD BY AIK BUT REACH SEMIFINALS.

text.p: Barcelona were held 1-1 by AIK Stockholm in their European Cup Winners' Cup quarter-final second leg match on Thursday but reached the semifinals 4-2 on aggregate.
Freezing temperatures of minus four degrees Celsius at Stockholm's Rasunda stadium failed to inhibit the Spaniards, who quickly added to their 3-1 first-leg lead.

Brazilian striker Ronaldo lived up to the crowd's high expectations in the 12th minute when he scored a textbook goal, receiving a well-timed pass from midfielder Ivan de la Pena and driving his shot into the roof of the net.
But AIK adopted more aggressive tactics in the second half and equalised in the 75th minute through Pascal Simpson.
The goal rejuvenated AIK, with Johan Mjallby making an effective move from defence into midfield, but despite two near attempts they could not overturn Barcelona's advantage.
